tagline: Protecting the American Dream of Homeownership
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin is the primary indicator of operational performance in mortgage insurance, reflecting the company's ability to manage underwriting costs and claims provisions relative to premium revenues.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and cost of services, expressed as a percentage of revenues.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves in 2025, driven by lower claims provisions and stable premiums.
kpis.signal: Higher gross margin due to improved claims management.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin increases due to disciplined overhead management and increased digitalization.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount declines slightly in 2025, despite targeted hiring in technology and cybersecurity.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in headcount due to process automation.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses divided by revenues.
kpis.description: Radian increases R&D spending to modernize its underwriting and risk management platforms.
kpis.signal: Higher tech investments for service digitalization.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual spending on tangible and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures increase primarily in IT infrastructure and automation tools.
kpis.signal: Higher Capex to strengthen digital systems.

kpis.name: Bond Portfolio Duration
kpis.explanation: Average sensitivity of the bond portfolio to interest rate changes.
kpis.description: Radian reduced the duration of its portfolio in 2025 to adapt to a high-interest-rate environment. The average bond portfolio duration decreased from 4.3 years to 3.6 years.
kpis.signal: Duration reduction to limit interest rate risk.

kpis.name: Assets Held for Sale
kpis.explanation: Book value of assets currently being disposed.
kpis.description: Radian continues to divest non-core assets, decreasing from $207M to $110M between December 2024 and December 2025.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in non-strategic asset portfolio.

ai_positioning.summary: Radian is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its underwriting and claims management processes, without positioning it as a major strategic lever. The focus is on automating repetitive tasks.
evidence: Appointment of a Chief Digital Officer until July 2026
Increased R&D spending related to digitalization
No explicit mention of generative AI in company documents
